text: The doctor spoke very kindly, and the assistant was lovely. / I was very impressed.

The doctor's service was excellent. I had a tooth extracted today, which cost 800 baht. I was under anesthesia throughout the procedure, so I didn't feel any pain. The doctor's hands were very gentle. 👍🏻 Absolutely fantastic, highly recommended! …
I went for gap closure treatment, and the dentist did an excellent job. I have a beautiful smile for just a few thousand baht. The staff were also very friendly.
Good service, clean interior, easy to find.
